 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e379ebdc",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# 1. From a CMS chamber to a plot\n",
    "\n",
    "mplDTs 3.0 splits the geometry into four layers, and this notebook walks down\n",
    "them once:\n",
    "\n",
    "```\n",
    "specs            nodes              frames            views / exports\n",
    "frozen data  ->  build_station  ->  FrameGraph   ->   Station, DTStationPatch\n",
    "(specs.py)       (model.py)         (frames.py)       TgSink\n",
    "```\n",
    "\n",
    "The 2.x API (`DTGeometry`, `DTGEOMETRY`, the station cache) is gone. Everything\n",
    "below is the replacement, and nothing else is needed to draw a chamber."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "ec64475f",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:11.139251Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:11.139003Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.621094Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.619453Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "250 chambers in the file\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "[(-2, 1, 1), (-2, 1, 2), (-2, 1, 3)]"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 1,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline\n",
    "from mpldts.geometry.sources import CMSXMLSource\n",
    "\n",
    "source = CMSXMLSource()          # the only reader of DTGeometry_v3.xml, parsed once\n",
    "print(len(source.chamber_keys()), \"chambers in the file\")\n",
    "source.chamber_keys()[:3]"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "3bc9ad0c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## The source hands out specs\n",
    "\n",
    "A **spec** is frozen data: parent-relative poses, shapes and names. It holds no\n",
    "derived value, so it can be validated, written to JSON and edited by hand."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "8a8db182",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.624668Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.624169Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.633620Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.631667Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "StationSpec | W-2_S1_MB2 | G4_AIR\n",
      "super layers: [1, 3, 2]\n",
      "layer 1 cells: 59 at 4.19999981 cm pitch\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "spec = source.station(-2, 1, 2)\n",
    "print(type(spec).__name__, \"|\", spec.name, \"|\", spec.material)\n",
    "print(\"super layers:\", [sl.number for sl in spec.super_layers])\n",
    "grid = spec.super_layers[0].layers[0].cells\n",
    "print(\"layer 1 cells:\", grid.count, \"at\", grid.pitch, \"cm pitch\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "c369c2d0",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.635772Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.635532Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.644165Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.642213Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "['attachments', 'material', 'name', 'pose', 'schema', 'shape', 'super_layers']"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 3,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from mpldts.geometry.serialize import to_dict\n",
    "from mpldts.geometry.specs import validate\n",
    "\n",
    "validate(spec)                   # raises if the document is inconsistent\n",
    "document = to_dict(spec)\n",
    "sorted(document)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "6d507420",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Nodes: one pose per object\n",
    "\n",
    "`build_station` turns the spec into a tree of nodes. Super layers and layers are\n",
    "grouping nodes, so they have no solid of their own; the cells are the only\n",
    "children with gas and a shape."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "25ed30cd",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.646745Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.646500Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.664349Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.662998Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "station node : /W-2_S1_MB2 | station | G4_AIR\n",
      "children     : ['SL1', 'SL3', 'SL2']\n",
      "first cell   : /W-2_S1_MB2/SL1/L1/C1 | GasMixture | (4.19999981, 234.800003, 1.29999995)\n",
      "world centre : [498.775, -140.88, -533.35]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from mpldts.geometry import build_station\n",
    "\n",
    "node = build_station(spec)\n",
    "print(\"station node :\", node.frame_id, \"|\", node.kind, \"|\", node.material)\n",
    "print(\"children     :\", [child.name for child in node.children])\n",
    "\n",
    "cell = node.children[0].children[0].children[0]\n",
    "print(\"first cell   :\", cell.frame_id, \"|\", cell.material, \"|\", cell.shape.aabb())\n",
    "print(\"world centre :\", [round(float(v), 3) for v in cell.world_pose.translation])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5fc40d2f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Views: the objects the plotting patches consume\n",
    "\n",
    "`Station.from_spec` builds the spec and wraps the node tree. A view answers with\n",
    "centres, bounds and transforms; it never copies the geometry."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "0a8ba149",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.667879Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.667548Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.730944Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.728861Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "wheel/sector/station: -2 1 2\n",
      "bounds (w, t, l)    : [266.8, 36.2, 251.1]\n",
      "local centre        : [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from mpldts.geometry import Station\n",
    "\n",
    "station = Station.from_spec(spec, -2, 1, 2)\n",
    "print(\"wheel/sector/station:\", station.wheel, station.sector, station.number)\n",
    "print(\"bounds (w, t, l)    :\", [round(float(v), 2) for v in station.bounds])\n",
    "print(\"local centre        :\", [round(float(v), 3) for v in station.local_center])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "1f8285b7",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.734218Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:13.733968Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:14.033427Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:14.031627Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1300x400 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from mpldts.patches import DTStationPatch\n",
    "\n",
    "width, height, length = station.bounds\n",
    "x, y, z = station.local_center\n",
    "\n",
    "figure, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 4))\n",
    "for axis, faceview in zip(axes, (\"phi\", \"eta\")):\n",
    "    DTStationPatch(station, axis, faceview=faceview, local=True)\n",
    "    if faceview == \"phi\":\n",
    "        axis.set_xlim(x - width / 2 - 5, x + width / 2 + 5)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        axis.set_xlim(y - length / 2 - 5, y + length / 2 + 5)\n",
    "    axis.set_ylim(z - height / 2 - 5, z + height / 2 + 5)\n",
    "    axis.set_title(\"chamber %s: %s view\" % (station.name, faceview))\n",
    "    axis.set_xlabel(\"x [cm]\")\n",
    "    axis.set_ylabel(\"z [cm]\")\n",
    "figure.tight_layout()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "325f6251",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Frames: moving a point between reference frames\n",
    "\n",
    "Every node has a slash-separated `frame_id` and one parent-relative pose. The\n",
    "`transformer` resolves a path in one call - here from a cell to CMS coordinates."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "bf4ef234",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:14.036215Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:14.035993Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:14.045384Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:14.041451Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "/W-2_S1_MB2/SL1/L1/C1\n",
      "cell -> CMS: [498.775, -140.88, -533.35]\n",
      "cell -> Station: [-119.45, 0.0, 13.7]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "view_cell = station.super_layer(1).layer(1).cell(1)\n",
    "print(view_cell.transformer.node.frame_id)\n",
    "print(\"cell -> CMS:\", [round(float(v), 3) for v in\n",
    "                        view_cell.transformer.transform((0, 0, 0), \"Cell\", \"CMS\")])\n",
    "print(\"cell -> Station:\", [round(float(v), 3) for v in\n",
    "                            view_cell.transformer.transform((0, 0, 0), \"Cell\", \"Station\")])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "14e61983",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## What changed against 2.x\n",
    "\n",
    "| 2.x | 3.0 |\n",
    "|---|---|\n",
    "| `DTGeometry('DTGeometry.xml')` | `CMSXMLSource()` and `Station.from_spec(source.station(w, se, st))` |\n",
    "| `DTGEOMETRY` module-level instance | there is no cache: build the view you need |\n",
    "| `StationsCache` | the spec is the cache; a view build is cheap |\n",
    "| XML-backed station, super layer, layer, cell | specs, nodes and views |\n",
    "| `TransformManager` | `FrameGraph`, reached through `station.transformer` |\n",
    "\n",
    "Next: [2. per-event data](02-event-data.ipynb) shows how an event is drawn\n",
    "without touching any of this, and [3. your own detector](03-own-detector.ipynb)\n",
    "builds one that is not in the CMS file."
   ]
  }
 ],
